about: E12 Amendment 1: the route split on teacher-trained states. Plan reports/plans/2026-11-02_plan_e12-teacher-route-split.md (2026-11-02), run by the user's decision of 2026-11-02 (backlog.md, 2026-11-02 entry). experiments/new_vs_existing/amend1.py refuses to start without this file or if `config` differs.
request_in_the_terms_words: On each of E12's eight full-weight fine-tunes (copy and random-map key to value tasks, two seeds, first learned step), run teacher training (component training with loss KL(teacher || student), teacher = the fine-tuned model, Gamma and Delta frozen). Read the route split at the trigger on 97 held-out windows. Does the masked-off share e_gate separate the classes by E12's rule, and what share of the copy's gain is re-switching r against masked-off?

readings.state_a: Teacher training's own state, Delta fixed: target W0 + the student's change, components the student's U', V'. SCORED FIRST (user, 2026-11-02). r moves, since Gamma reads the student's activations.
readings.state_b: Plus remainder: target the fine-tune's W0 + dW, components the same student's U', V'. Read beside (a) by the same rule, reported in each prediction's `state_b`. r is E12's by code; U1 is the same as (a)'s; L11 differs through the gates G1, and the gain is the fine-tune's.

measurements.route split: local_faith.route_split at the trigger, 97 held-out windows of E46's windows_<task>.pt, target = the task's lookup table, batch 64. Cells: L(C, G) masked with components C and gates G, Delta out; U unmasked, Delta out; T the target model; subscripts 0 = W0, 1 = the state. Quantity: mean log-odds of the target. Held fixed: Gamma, windows, C0. Varied: target weights and components.
measurements.r: (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0), absolute: what Gamma's new gates give the released subcomponents, over the state's own gain
measurements.e_gate: ((U1 - L11) - (U0 - L00)) / (T1 - T0), absolute: the masked-off share, carried by subcomponents Gamma does not gate on
measurements.teacher's gain: the gain of the do-nothing read of the same fine-tune, same card
measurements.state: a state's name is <task>_<seed>, order-1 states <task>_s0_o1. Students are compared only from their trained fp32 weights
measurements.scored step: the students at step 1000; the teachers at E12's first learned step (10, or 30 on rand32b), stage0a's files

pool: For all three predictions, over the 8 batch-order-0 students, on state (a): a state enters only if its five shares are finite, gain >= 1 nat (MIN_GAIN), and gain / teacher's gain >= 0.5. Dropped states are listed in score.dropped. State (b)'s own gain is the fine-tune's, so its ratio could not fail: (b) reads the same pool, less any state whose (b) shares are not finite.

P1.claim: e_gate of state (a) separates the copy class from the random-map class, by E12's rule
P1.rule: Absolute. gap = min(map) - max(copy); within = the larger class range; gap > within: 'separates'. swapped_gap = min(copy) - max(map); swapped_gap > within: 'reversed'. Otherwise 'no separation', reported with both numbers. Under 3 states in a class: 'unscorable'. State (b) reported by the same rule (state_b), not the verdict.
P1.blind_to: which subcomponents; one position; on these states e_gate is nearly 1 - r, so it is not independent of P2
P1.positive_control: C0: the least-squares e_gate separates on this card by the same rule (E12: gap 0.33, within 0.09); a miss stops the job
P1.noise_floor: batch-order |delta e_gate| on ident32 s0 and rand32 s0, reported as noise_e_gate; the class range is in the rule

P2.claim: whether a student keeps its fine-tune's re-switching share
P2.rule: Over the pool, |r(state (a)) - r(do-nothing of the same fine-tune)|, absolute. Under 3 states in a class, or no batch-order pair with both states in the pool: 'unscorable'. Else any batch-order |delta r| > 0.05: 'no power'. Else any move >= 0.25: 'moved'. Else all moves <= 0.10: 'inherited'. Else 'partly'. 0.10 is 'inherited' and 0.25 is 'moved'.
P2.lean: partly, medium (E42 moved 0.01-0.06 at step-1000 teachers, but step-10 teachers overshoot: E43's 5.1 times)
P2.blind_to: whether the same subcomponents switch; each r is over its own gain
P2.positive_control: C0: do-nothing's r equals least-squares' within 1e-6; a miss stops the job. First student: r of state (b) equals do-nothing's within 1e-6
P2.noise_floor: batch-order |delta r| on the two pairs, which is in the rule; 0.002 across cards (E46)

P3.claim: where the copy's gain sits: masked-off or not, on state (a)
P3.rule: Per copy state in the pool, E42's filed lines on e_gate, absolute: >= 0.5 'masked-off'; <= 0.25 'not masked-off'; else 'mixed'. The end classes take negatives and values over 1; 0.25 and 0.5 go to the end classes. Answer: the class of strictly more than half of the copy states in the pool. Any other split (2-2, 2-1-1, 1-1-1), or under 3 copy states: 'unsettled'. State (b) reported by the same rule (state_b).
P3.lean: not masked-off, low-medium (E42 0.25 at step 100, 0.31 at step 1000)
P3.blind_to: which subcomponents; one position; nearly 1 - r, so not independent of P1 or P2
P3.positive_control: E42's rand32 and rand1 read masked-off (0.84, 0.92) under these lines; none in this job
P3.noise_floor: batch-order |delta e_gate| on ident32 s0, reported as noise_e_gate

r.student (b): E12's, exactly the fine-tune's on this card

expected.read_from_the_code: Do-nothing keeps the released components, so U1 = U0, L10 = L00 and L11 = L01 are the same forwards: d = i = 0, e_gate = -r, and 1 - r - e_gate = 1, all to rounding. E42's rand32 file reads d 0, i 0, r + e_gate 0 exactly. W0 itself is not read by route_split; its cells T0, U0, L00 are the check.

stop_rules.inputs: sha256 of the 8 fine-tunes and 4 windows files against stage0a.json, before the model loads; amend8/n1/0.pt must exist, its sha256 recorded
stop_rules.C0: W0 cells T0, U0, L00 of each task against stage0a.json's on-card readings within 0.02 nats (E46's). Do-nothing r against E12's within 0.03 (E46's). Do-nothing e_gate + r within 1e-6. Do-nothing r against least-squares r within 1e-6. Least-squares e_gate 'separates' over the 8 states
stop_rules.C1: Teacher = W0 from amend8/n1/0.pt, 1000 steps, rand32 windows then ident32. Stop if |r term| or |e_gate term| at step 1000 exceeds 1.5 nats (0.11 x the smallest teacher gain 13.2; 0.11 is a third of E12's smallest e_gate gap 0.33). Absolute value: a large negative term also means training alone writes into the route. The start's terms are reported, not stopped on, because the start is a random move, not training
stop_rules.first student: ident32 s0: stop if the share sum of (a) or (b) misses 1 within 1e-6; its gain / teacher's is under 0.5; r of (b) misses do-nothing's within 1e-6; U1 of (a) misses U1 of (b) within 1e-6. The last two hold by code and test the read's path
stop_rules.later students: no stop: a state that learned too little leaves the pool and is listed

edge_cases_run_before_filing: ~/commute-data/scratch/commute-lead/e12-amend1-writer/edge.py on amend1.py's rule functions, 2026-11-02, all as expected on the filed text: empty and one-element pools, a class short or wholly dropped, NaN shares, ties at gap = within, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, gain ratio exactly 0.5, a lost noise pair, (b) NaN on a state in (a)'s pool, 2-2, 2-1-1, 1-1-1. Three cases the plan's draft left open were fixed before filing: see changes_from_the_plan_rules.
changes_from_the_plan_rules: P2: 'empty pool: unscorable' widened to under 3 states in a class, as P1, since moves over one class alone or over one state read 'inherited' too easily. A pool with no batch-order pair also 'unscorable': the 'no power' test could not run, a case the plan did not cover. Order fixed: unscorable, no power, moved, inherited, partly.
P3: the plan's 'majority class; a 2-2 tie or under 3 states unsettled' left 2-1-1 and 1-1-1 uncovered. Filed as strictly more than half of the states; anything else 'unsettled'.
Pool on state (b): the plan's ratio could not fail on (b), whose gain is the fine-tune's, so (b) reads (a)'s pool.
C1's stop line is on the absolute term; the plan says 'above 1.5 nats'.

departures.from_E12: A different state (student's weights, so T1, G1 and the gain change); only P4's two numbers; L40, not A40; teachers are E46's rebuilds (T1 within 0.03 nats), E12's bytes being lost.
departures.from_E42: Teachers at the first learned step (10 or 30), not 1000; rand32's teacher holds P only 0.55-0.59, a confound carried from E12; no Pile harness.
departures.from_Amendment_8_n1: C1's start is the saved bf16 offsets, so it differs from n1's by their rounding; its windows are these tasks', not emoticon's; fresh Adam state and batch order 0, as n1.
departures.from_VPD: U and V alone on an unmasked KL to a teacher, Gamma and Delta frozen, no sparsity or masked loss. The route split is this project's measure, not the paper's. Gamma sees 41-token windows where it trained on rows of 512, and it is bidirectional (review 2026-10-27).
departures.from_Kingma_and_Ba: Adam with default betas, plus clip 1 and no warm-up, carried from E34.

limits_carried: A new circuit from old pieces reads 'elicited' to VPD, and E50 Amendment 1 did not show W0 performs the copy task, so the classes are 'copy' and 'random map', not 'existing' and 'new'.
what_changes_next: Separates and r stays close: E42's claim widens to two tables per class, nothing further runs. No separation, or r moves: the route is not a kind reading of a map's state, the re-gating line's r stays on the fine-tuned model only, and the user hears it before anything else runs.
not_run: Pile harness on any student; the Pile-text arm; step 100; more than two batch orders
Step-1000 teachers on ident32b and rand32b, the cheapest follow-up if P1 does not separate
Which subcomponents switch on in a student, overlap with E12's switched-on sets, switched-on counts
A null teacher on these windows; a second random start; E12's P1, P2, P3, P5 on these states; other tasks; Qwen; cheap-method arms and method-table rows (baseline-lead's)
